# Summary
Draft from the July 2026 batch (see [Summit AZ - Blog - July 2026 Batch Brief](lib:brain-summit-az-blog-july-2026-batch-brief)), written to the brief's META BLOCK, article and Verification format.

# Key facts
- Focus keyphrase: slow draining sink. SEO title: "Slow Draining Sink? Causes and Fixes for AZ Homes (50 chars)".
- Quick answer: Usually buildup (hair and soap in bathrooms, grease and food in kitchens), a clogged P-trap, hard-water scale or a partial vent problem.
- Links: `/slow-drains/` service, drain cleaning pillar, garbage disposals pillar, siblings (prevent clogged drains, sewer line backup), contact. No external sources (qualitative only).
- Verification block: keyphrase placements, single H1, no em dashes, cannibalization and Arizona localization all marked PASS; Kim to confirm internal URLs and .gov links load in a browser.

# Status
- Not published as of 2026-10-12. Links to the unpublished sewer-line-backup post, so that link must be removed or replaced before any publish.
